desc: Parse input: N, X, then arrays V_i, A_i, C_i. Group foods by vitamin type (1,2,3).

Implement a helper function `min_calories(vitamin_type, M)` that runs 0/1 knapsack DP with size `M+1` over foods of that type, returning minimal calories to achieve at least `M` vitamin units (or `inf` if impossible).
Implement feasibility check `can(M)`: compute `min_calories(1,M) + min_calories(2,M) + min_calories(3,M)`, return True if sum ≤ X.
Binary search on `M` from 0 to `max_possible` (max of sum of A_i for any vitamin type). Use standard binary search for maximum feasible `M`.
